decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The work to which this consent relates shall be begun not later than three years from the date of this consent. 
Reason: To comply with the requirements of Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The works of demolition/alteration hereby authorised shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following plans and specifications:
LOCATION PLAN, 2526.04.001  REV A, 2526.04.501 REV A, 2526.04.502 REV A, 2526.04.401 REV B, 2526.04.403 REV A, 2526.04.601 REV A, 2526.04.602 REV A, 2526.04.603 REV A, 2526.04.402 REV B, SK 01 SK 02, SK 03, SK 04
Reason: To safeguard the character of the building, in accordance with Council policy LP3 of the Local Plan.
Condition : 3 - Prior to the commencement of any works affecting the historic fabric of the listed building, detailed drawings showing the proposed service runs shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall clearly identify all new service runs and distinguish from those proposed to reuse the existing service runs and those which would be additional to the current layout. The approved works shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Reason: To safeguard the historic interest of the listed building by ensuring that the installation of services minimises harm to historic fabric.
Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of any works to the south porch, a detailed schedule and method statement for the stabilisation, underpinning and rebuilding of the south porch, together with all proposed stonework repairs, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include the extent of removal of existing fabric, specifications for replacement materials, repair techniques, and methods of construction and conservation. The works shall thereafter be implemented in accordance with the approved details.
Reason: To ensure that repairs to the listed building are undertaken using appropriate conservation methods that preserve its historic interest.
Condition : 5 - Prior to the removal of the altar table and decorative painted screen from the building, a statement detailing their future retention, reuse, relocation, storage or disposal shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved arrangements shall be implemented in full prior to the completion of the development.
Reason: To secure an appropriate outcome for features that, whilst not fixtures of the listed building, contribute to its historic character and significance.
Condition : 6 - Prior to the commencement of development, a scheme for the protection of all decorative features and historic fabric within the listed building during the course of the repair, conversion and construction works shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved protection measures shall be installed before works commence and retained for the duration of the construction period.
Reason: To ensure that the architectural and historic features of the listed building are adequately protected during the implementation of the approved works.
Condition : 7 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
description: Listed Building Consent is sought of internal alterations to allow the chapel to be adapted for residential use;  repair and rationalisation of later floor build-ups where required; removal or alteration of low-significance later insertions, including modern ceilings, partitions and defective linings;  structural repairs and strengthening works ; localised works to roof structure, purlins, lintels and supporting elements;  repairs to masonry, stone;  installation of new services in a manner designed to minimise impact on historic fabric; internal finishes and making-good using breathable, compatible materials.
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_:
This application should be read in the context of previous related applications for Diprose Chapel, which established a staged, conservation-led approach to understanding, repairing and adapting the building.
Application ref. 2025/4580 related to investigative and enabling works, including opening-up, removal of later non-historic fabric, local repairs and investigations. These works were intended to understand the building’s construction, condition and causes of deterioration, and to establish an evidential basis for future conservation proposals.
Application ref. 2026/0300 related to the dismantling and removal of the non-historic rood screen.
Application ref. 2026/0588 related to internal and external repairs and the removal of the non-original rood screen.
The present application represents a further related stage in the conservation-led repair and reuse of Diprose Chapel, bringing forward a more developed proposal for its long-term residential adaptation, informed by opening-up works, site investigation, design development and structural engineer’s advice.
